module: Flowgraph node "Parking Markers" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Creates a rectangular parking spot: a Box-type BeamNGTrigger and 4 corner markers (TSStatic art/shapes/interface/position_marker.dae) placed on the ground, colored depending on whether the vehicle is inside. Outputs: inside, outside, partlyInside, stopped, stopping, stoppedPercent, dotAngle, forward, sideDistance, forwardDistance (and relative versions, hidden). Detects stopping (speed <= 0.15 m/s for stop_timer s).
notes: Bug: in checkParking, sc is filled from self.pinIn.position (instead of scale): sideDistanceRelative and forwardDistanceRelative are divided by the position, not by the size.
updateMarkerPositions overwrites the color of each marker with "1 0 0 1" on every change; checkParking then recolors it.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes trigger, markers, debug=false and stopTimer=1.

clear.desc: Deletes the created trigger and markers and resets the state to zero.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets stopTimer to 1 and marks the state as changed.

_executionStopped.desc: Calls clear when the graph stops.

work.desc: On clear, deletes everything and empties the outputs; on flow, handles the trigger, repositions the markers and checks the parking.

checkParking.desc: Tests whether the 8 corners of the vehicle's bounding box are inside the trigger, colors the markers and computes the outputs (inside, partlyInside, distances, stopping).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

createCornerMarker.desc: Creates a corner-marker TSStatic registered under the given name and adds it to the MissionGroup.

updateMarkerPositions.desc: If the spot changed, repositions each marker on the ground (raycast) aligning its normal, or flat if staticMarkers.

manageTrigger.desc: Creates the BeamNGTrigger (position, scale, rotation) on the first call, then updates it if the pins change.
